question.text: A Cat III AIF distributor's role POST-INVESTMENT includes:

answer.text: Supporting capital calls/drawdowns, transfer documentation, investor approvals, investor reports, meetings, co-investment requirements, fund performance and grievance handling

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook post-investment distributor services cover capital calls/drawdowns, transfer and documentation support, investor approvals, investor reports, meetings, co-investment requirements, fund performance and grievances. The Trap: Corporate actions are described as custodian activity, not a distributor post-investment role; generic monitoring also overstates the duty unless tied to investor reports, performance or grievance support. Note: Map post-investment work directly to capital calls, transfers, approvals, reports, meetings, co-investment, performance and grievance handling.
